scientific_integrity: Proof is analytic for arbitrary positive integer part sizes and k>=2, using symmetric similarity, a secular equation, eigenspace observability, and a monic-polynomial Vandermonde identity. Exact rational finite checks are corroboration, not an infinite proof. General spectral observability and the Vandermonde principle are pre-existing tools.
scientific_limitations: Only part-constant signals on complete multipartite graphs under row-stochastic random-walk evolution; not all graph signals.
The invariant part-constant spectral subspace need not be a contiguous low-pass graph Paley-Wiener cutoff.
Exact noiseless measurements at times 0 through k-1; not a sharp minimum-time classification for multiple sensors.
The single-sensor determinant quantifies volume but not directly the smallest singular value or a quantitative noise-robust lower frame bound.
Full text of the 2026 motivating paper was inaccessible to this review; independently verified publication novelty is not asserted.
title: Exact sensor multiplicity and Krylov volume for multipartite graph Fourier bands
